CODE 
2.3.13. 
Preferential allocation in the event of death
 Where the matrimonial property regime is terminated by the death of one of the spouses, the surviving spouse may, in return for a cash payment if applicable, be awarded by preference, insofar as they belong to the joint estate or to the estate which is jointly owned exclusively by the spouses:
  1¡ any immovable property used as a family dwelling;
  2¡ the furniture that furnishes it;
  3¡ the property he uses for the exercise of his profession or the operation of his business.
